title: SimulationRun
description: Schema for a single simulation run result, including provenance data for Constitution Principle VI.

network_id.description: Unique identifier for the network graph used in this simulation.

seed.description: Random seed used for the simulation execution.

diffusion_rate.description: Calculated rate of energy diffusion (spatial variance change over time).

steps_run.description: Number of simulation time steps executed.

generation_algorithm.description: Name of the algorithm used to generate the network (sourced from T019 metadata).

parameter_values.description: Dictionary of string keys and float values representing the parameters used for graph generation.
